headline: Names a Johnson City, Tennessee post office after Major Homer L. Pease.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 530 East Main Street in Johnson City, Tennessee, as the "Major Homer L. Pease Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or who it serves.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the renaming took effect at that time.
